input.question: How much does an outgoing international wire cost, and what is the cut-off time?

expected_output: Outgoing international wires cost USD 35 (free for Premier accounts); the cut-off is 3:00 PM local time on business days, later wires go the next business day.

input.question: What is the late payment fee on the Classic credit card?

expected_output: The late payment fee is USD 29.

input.question: How long do I have to dispute a card transaction, and when do I get a provisional credit?

expected_output: You can dispute within 60 days of the statement date; a provisional credit is issued within 10 business days while the case is investigated (up to 45 days, 90 for international).

input.question: How does overdraft protection work and what does it cost?

expected_output: Overdraft protection is opt-in and covers up to USD 500 for USD 15 per day overdrawn, maximum 3 fees per month; with it off, such transactions are declined at no charge.

input.question: ¿Cuánto cuesta una transferencia internacional y cuál es la hora de corte?

expected_output: Una transferencia internacional saliente cuesta USD 35 (gratis para cuentas Premier); la hora de corte es las 3:00 PM hora local en días hábiles.

input.question: ¿Cómo funciona la protección de sobregiro y cuánto cuesta?

expected_output: Es opcional; cubre hasta USD 500 con un cargo de USD 15 por día en sobregiro, máximo 3 cargos al mes.
